notes.title: Countryball Strategy Game Demo Update 1
notes.notes:
Countryball Strategy Game Demo Update 1, Introduces a number of additional features and Bug fixes 

Demo- https://store.steampowered.com/app/2405310/Countryball_The_Real_Time_Strategy_Game/

-Added WASD for Camera Control
-Added Full screen and the option to toggle full screen in the Option menu
-Added the ability to cancel Units by (Right Clicking the next in Queue)
-Added the option to go to the (Main menu) from the mission screen
-Added Edge Scrolling (Mouse can now move the camera when at the edge of the screen)
-Added Repair Button next to the Demolish Button
-Added Melee Soldier Outfit
-Added Ranged Soldier Outfit
-Added Worker Outfit

-Fixed some issues that caused lag

-------------------------------

-Outfitter removed for reworking

Please Report all bugs on the discord!
https://discord.gg/3QgasjGPHM

And dont forget the check ou the kickstarter Launching April 10th 11:00AM EST
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/insectkingdoms/countryball-world-war-the-war-to-end-all-wars
